parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 rows from the metabolism table without adding any sorting. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id as a mandatory inner join, then join compound_structures on molregno as a mandatory inner join to obtain canonical_smiles and substrate_compound_key from the substrate side. Join metabolism to compound_records on metabolite_record_id as an optional left join to obtain metabolite_compound_key. Return exactly canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, and pathway_key.
